translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Joma kare tho, to onge ngʼama wachno chando e chunye,
joma ogeno kuom Nyasaye bende tho,
to onge ngʼama dewo
kendo joma kare igolo mondo kik richo yudgi.
Joma timbegi ni kare yudo kwe;
kendo giyudo yweyo ka ginindo e liel.
“To un, biuru un yawuot jojuogi,
ma koth terruok kod chode!
En ngʼa ma ujaro? En ngʼa mutingʼorene malo
kendo kumilone leu?
Donge un koth jonjore ma jo-miriambo?
Uoworu gi gombo manono ka un e tiend yiend ober
kod yiende mamoko motimo otiep;
kendo kanyo ema uwangʼoe nyithindu
ka misengini e holni kendo e kuonde rogo.
Kar dak mar nyisecheni ni e kind hoho
motimo lwendni mapoth,
kuno ema ogandau nitie.
Ee, kuondego ema usechiwoe misengini miolo piny,
kod misengini mag cham.
Kaluwore gi gigi duto,
bende anyalo weyonu?
Iseloso kitanda mari kama otingʼore gi malo;
kanyo ema isechiwoe misenginigi.
E tok dhoutu kod ewi sirni
mag dhoutu useketoe kido mar nyisecheu manono.
Adier useweya mabor muchalo nyiri molonyore duk
kendo unindo e kitanda malach ma useloso;
usetimo winjruok gi joma uhero kitendinigi
kendo ne uneno dugegi.
Ne uterone ruoth Molek mo zeituni
kod modhi moko mangʼwe ngʼar.
Ne uoro jombetre mau e piny mabor;
to gikone ne utundo mana e tho owuon!
Kata nobedo ni timbegi mamono duto nooli kamano;
to ne ok inyal wacho ni, ‘Gionge tich.’
Nibedo gi teko
kendo omiyo chunyi ne ok onyosore.
“En ngʼatno ma chunyu ogeno ahinya kendo uluoro,
momiyo usebedona jo-miriambo,
kendo ok usepara kata mana paro wechena e chunyu?
Koso en nikech uneno ni aselingʼ ahinya,
momiyo ok useluora?
Abiro nyiso ayanga timbeu makare kod tijeu,
kendo ok ginikelnu konyruok.
We ane nyisecheni manonogo okonyi sa ma inie chandruok!
Yamo mafuto biro yweyogi oko duto,
kata mana muya matin nono nokudhgi matergi mabor.
To ngʼama oloka kar pondone nokaw piny,
mi goda maler nobed mwandune.”
“Buguru yo, bugeuru kendo ulose maber!
Goluru gik madichwany joga e yo.”
Nimar ma e gima Jal Man Malo Moloyo
ma en Jal modak nyaka chiengʼ,
ma nyinge ler wacho,
“Adak kama ler man malo,
kaachiel gi ngʼat mofwenyo richone
kendo man-gi chuny mobolore,
mondo aduog chuny ngʼat moboloreno
kendo ajiw chuny ngʼat mofwenyo richone.
Ok anabed ka adhawo ndalo duto,
kata bedo gi ich wangʼ kinde duto,
nimar katimo kamano,
to chuny dhano biro nyosore e nyima,
ma en muya mane aketo kuom dhano.
Ne akecho gi timbene mamono ma ok rum,
ne amiye kum, kendo apandone wangʼa ka an-gi mirima,
to kata kamano nomedo mana
dhiyo nyime gi timbene mamonogo.
Aseneno yorene to kata kamano abiro change;
abiro nyise yo kendo aho chunye;
ka achiwo wende pak e dho jo-Israel man-gi kuyo.
Kwe, kwe, ne jogo man machiegni kod man maboyo.
Kendo abiro changogi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
To joricho chalo gi nam moduwore,
ma ok nyal bedo gi kwe,
ma apaka mage gingore kendo kelo chwodho.
Nyasacha wacho niya,
“Onge kwe ne joricho.”
